plugin.note: Crush melee with venom protection; carry a halberd or a heavy ranged switch for mirrorbacks. Araxxor requires 92 Slayer and an active araxyte or spider task.

requirements: 92 Slayer, completion of Priest in Peril and an active araxyte or spider assignment are required.
The Wiki recommends 85 Attack, Strength and Hitpoints, 70 Defence and Prayer; these recommendations are not entry requirements.
Sins of the Father is an optional Hallowed Sepulchre travel route requirement, not an encounter requirement.
mechanics: Araxxor favours crush melee; ranged is an alternative with expensive equipment. The listed fire weakness does not make ordinary magic competitive against his magic defence.
Venom protection, spawn handling and the enrage phase are separate preparation requirements; Protect from Melee alone does not prevent special-attack damage.

methods.label: Crush melee with mirrorback halberd
methods.summary: The main melee setup uses crush damage and a Noxious halberd switch to avoid mirrorback melee recoil.
prayers: Protect from Melee; best available melee offensive prayer
steps: Use the main weapon on crush where supported; keep Araxxor in melee distance for his lower-damage standard attacks.
Use the specified switch on white mirrorbacks from beyond adjacent melee range. Hatched araxytes have 58 Hitpoints; eggs have 65 and do not share the guaranteed-max-hit rule.
Plan movement around acid and red araxytes, then use the separate enrage reference below the 25% health threshold.
risks: An adjacent halberd hit still takes mirrorback recoil; the extra tile of reach is essential.

methods.label: Twisted bow alternative
methods.summary: Twisted bow with fortified Masori is a ranged alternative; the Wiki still prefers the strongest crush melee setups.
prayers: Protect from Melee; best available ranged offensive prayer
steps: Maintain melee distance where practical to reduce Araxxor standard-attack damage; ranged weapons do not make the encounter a safespot.
Use heavy ballista and javelins for mirrorbacks; follow the same egg, acid and enrage procedures as melee.
risks: Ranged attacks used by Araxxor outside melee distance drain Defence; magic attacks drain Prayer.

methods.label: Task access and routes
methods.summary: Choose a route to the Morytania spider cave before the trip.
steps: Araxxor needs an active araxyte or spider task and 92 Slayer; destroying spawns does not decrement the assignment.
Spider cave teleport is the direct route. Hallowed crystal travel requires the Sins of the Father route and the relevant shortcut; the Wiki lists 63 Agility and two long ropes for that route.
Ectophial or fairy ring ALQ are longer approaches. Prepare venom protection, an emergency teleport and sufficient prayer supplies.

methods.label: Standard attacks and defence reduction
methods.summary: Melee positioning lowers incoming standard damage; defence reduction has a limited floor.
steps: Araxxor has 135 Defence with +15 crush defence. Defence may be reduced by at most 45 levels; one successful elder maul special reaches this cap, while dragon warhammer reduces 40.
Melee can hit 38, reduced to 5 through protection. Outside melee range the ranged attack can hit 34, reduced to 18, and drains 9% Defence; magic can hit 21 and drains 9% Prayer.
The ranged or magic choice considers the player defence rolls when the attack begins. Plan the main position and prayers before the attack rather than expecting a late equipment swap to change it.

methods.label: Aranea boots ranged-negation alternative
methods.summary: High magic defence can steer Araxxor towards the ranged attack that Aranea boots periodically block.
steps: Aranea boots negate Araxxor's ranged attack once every eight ticks, but do not block his magic attack.
High magic defence, most readily achieved with fortified Masori, can make ranged the chosen out-of-melee attack. Moving outside melee range every second attack exploits the boot cooldown.

Offensive prayers can change defence rolls and therefore the selected attack style. This advanced alternative requires the actual equipped defence profile; wearing the boots alone does not establish it.

methods.label: Egg rotation and spawn selection
methods.summary: The southeast egg colour fixes the repeating spawn order and associated boss special for the kill.
steps: Nine eggs surround the arena: three red, three white and three green. The first hatch follows three normal attacks, later hatches follow six. Hatching proceeds clockwise from the southeast egg.
The repeating colour sequences are green-white-red, white-red-green or red-green-white. The southeast colour determines the special attack sequence for that kill.

Destroying a full-health egg skips that spawn; damage to an egg carries into the hatch. More than 58 damage to an egg can make its hatch immediately despawn, advancing the next scheduled hatch after six attacks.

Hatched araxytes take guaranteed maximum hits from Noxious halberd, crush when crush is the highest attack bonus, or heavy ranged when ranged is the highest. Unhatched eggs do not receive this guarantee.

methods.label: White mirrorbacks and recoil
methods.summary: Remove mirrorbacks safely before continuing boss damage.
steps: A mirrorback redirects 20% of damage dealt to Araxxor and reflects half of that redirected damage, effectively 10%, to the player.
Direct adjacent melee attacks against mirrorbacks recoil half the hit. Use ranged, magic, or a halberd with a one-tile gap to avoid the direct melee recoil.

Noxious halberd is the preferred switch. Hunters' sunlight crossbow with antler bolts, Karil's crossbow with bolt racks, heavy ballista with javelins, or rune crossbow with broad bolts are source-listed ranged alternatives.
Vengeance is an optional Lunar alternative to exploit recoil, with its own spellbook and rune requirements; the Wiki generally favours Arceuus utility instead.

methods.label: White-start acid-splatter special
methods.summary: A white southeast egg identifies the acid-splatter special for the kill.
steps: Araxxor throws venom blobs in a broad arc around the player, dealing low venom damage and leaving acid pools.
As with acid ball, splatter damage can occur before the acid pool graphic forms. Do not assume visually clear newly targeted ground is safe.
Standing in acid deals progressively increasing damage starting at four, independently of whether venom is being cured or prevented.

methods.label: Green araxytes and acid
methods.summary: Green araxytes and acid specials create persistent movement hazards.
steps: Green araxytes use ranged attacks up to 15 and leave a 7-by-7 acid area on death. Killing or deliberately leaving them alive is a damage-versus-movement trade-off.
Acid ball travels in a line and creates 3-by-3 pools; a wall impact spreads a 7-by-7 area. Damage can occur before the acid graphic appears.
During acid drip, move continuously while staying within Araxxor melee reach. The Wiki describes a walking pattern for four-tick weapons; learn the pattern as static preparation before attempting it.
risks: Venom protection does not prevent standing-acid damage.

methods.label: Red araxytes and explosions
methods.summary: Red araxytes can damage the boss or remove another egg when carefully positioned.
steps: A red araxyte follows the player, then explodes in an 8-by-8 area. Player damage depends on remaining health and distance: up to 70 underneath, 49 adjacent, 28 at a one-tile gap and 7 at a two-tile gap.
Luring its explosion underneath Araxxor deals 80 damage, adjacent 64, decreasing to at least 33 at distance three.
An explosion can also be used on a white egg to avoid that mirrorback spawn. This is an optional efficiency technique with substantial positioning risk.

methods.label: Enrage below 255 Hitpoints
methods.summary: The final quarter changes attack speed and adds an acid cleave.
steps: At less than 255 Hitpoints, Araxxor gains 35 Defence, 28 Magic and 31 Ranged while retaining prior defence reductions; the attack cycle accelerates from six to four ticks.
The cleave covers a 1-by-3 strip two tiles long and leaves acid. Protection reduces its damage by roughly two thirds; remaining outside melee distance can trigger an alternate attack.
A two-tile sideways move or a one-tile retreat followed by a delayed move can avoid the strip. Stepping under Araxxor can bait 8-12 self-damage when performed correctly.
Five-tick weapons need a different cadence: three attacks over four cleaves, omitting a step-under when necessary to avoid losing an attack.

Aranea boots can negate a cleave once per twenty ticks but do not negate acid. Leaving green araxytes alive and using ranged protection is an advanced alternative only when cleaves are consistently avoided.

methods.label: Loot choice and trip sustain
methods.summary: The corpse must be resolved before the next spawn.
steps: Harvest for ordinary loot or destroy the corpse to double the pet roll while sacrificing ordinary loot other than an elite clue. Loot cannot be previewed before making that choice.
Araxxor does not respawn until the corpse is resolved, allowing planned restoration and supply collection. Dropped supplies remain for three hours.
Bring venom protection, prayer restoration, food, a boost potion, a special-attack option and the selected mirrorback switch. Re-check charged weapons and loaded ammunition before leaving.
